# Font test fixture

`OpenSans-Regular.ttf` is Open Sans 1.10, copyright 2010–2011 Google
Corporation, distributed under the Apache License 2.0. Its embedded name table
records the license and links to <http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0>.

This copy comes from the W3C EPUBCheck test corpus
(`resources-cmt-font-opentype-valid`) and is used to exercise HarfBuzz against
a legitimate TrueType font.

`Rochester.otf` is Rochester 1.005, copyright 2010 Font Diner, Inc. DBA
Sideshow, distributed under the Apache License 2.0. Its embedded name table
records the license and links to <http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0>.
This copy comes from the Web Platform Tests font-loading resources and exercises
the OpenType/CFF path.

Test fixtures are not included in the published npm package.
